title: Mara and the Ember
author: E. M. Pemberton
blurb: Edmund Nystrom, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
